req.title: Task deletion persists
req.statement: The system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404 for that id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a deleted task should not be retrievable, ensuring data consistency and integrity. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to verify the correct implementation of task deletion and its persistence.

tests.name: test_delete_task_success
preconditions: A task is created in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Delete the task
delete_response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
assert delete_response.status_code == 204

# Verify the task is deleted
get_response = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
assert get_response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_task
preconditions: No task exists with the given ID.
actions: Attempt to delete a task using DELETE /tasks/{task_id} with a non-existent ID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to delete a non-existent task
non_existent_task_id = 9999
delete_response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{non_existent_task_id}")
assert delete_response.status_code == 404
assert delete_response.json()['detail'] == f"Task with id {non_existent_task_id} not found"

tests.name: test_delete_task_boundary
preconditions: A task is created in the database.
actions: Attempt to delete the same task again.
expected: The first delete returns status code 204.
The second delete returns status code 404.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Delete the task
first_delete_response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
assert first_delete_response.status_code == 204

# Attempt to delete the same task again
second_delete_response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
assert second_delete_response.status_code == 404
assert second_delete_response.json()['detail'] == f"Task with id {task_id} not found"
